comment: Package kit hints for the robot assistant (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). It has no page of its own (web.page false): it draws an overlay over every page and adds a section to Account → Appearance, so the kit opens those pages instead. No demo data: the seed saves module settings and the superadmin's personal preferences through the module's own API. No other module links to it.

openToUsersWhy.prefs: the signed-in person's own robot settings (one row per person; the plain user gets their own defaults)
